# Error analysis (generated by scripts/06_explain_errors.py)

Decision threshold: p(malignant) >= 0.2.

* Training split, out-of-fold: 3 missed malignant (FN), 14 false alarms (FP).
* Held-out test split: 1 FN, 4 FP.
* 47% of out-of-fold errors had a predicted probability within 0.15 of the threshold (median distance 0.163).

## Reading the numbers

* Both error groups have a median position strictly between 0 and 1: on most of the top features they sit in the overlap between the class averages, not deep inside the wrong class.
* worst radius: TN 13.27, FP 16.22, FN 15.79, TP 21.38.
* worst area: TN 548.9, FP 811.6, FN 787.5, TP 1453.
* On these size features, false alarms are larger than typical benign tumors and missed cancers are smaller than typical malignant ones.
* Caveat: there are only 3 out-of-fold FN, so FN averages are noisy (a single unusual sample can move them a lot, including outside the 0-1 range).
* See figures/15_error_profile.png for the same comparison as a chart.
